data.name: Pseudo World
data.detailed_description:
Jump into the Pseudoverse and land on the planet of wars and heroes. Heed the prophecy of the Chosen One and save the world from yet another apocalypse.

Every person, place, and item is procedurally generated, making each adventure uniquely yours. When every quest has multiple possible outcomes, the narrative is entirely in your hands.

Game Features

  • Explore - Endless, unique, and alien places, brimming with untold history. From purple jungles to the moldy dungeons.

  • Fight - Hack and slash creatures of all shapes and sizes, using abilities that are simple to use but tough to master.

  • Collect - Obtain treasure, weapons, and costumes of all kinds. Anything you can't use, just sell it for a pretty penny.

  • Recruit - Make friends with the colorful characters you meet along the way and recruit them into your party. Be sure to keep them happy, though, or they may betray you...

Story

The monstrous space station of Destrox Pro looms over the city of Lan Redic, a constant reminder of the impending invasion. Join Almasy, a grump from another world, as he tries to avert the Landing of the Sky Bridges.

data.short_description: Roll your own story in Pseudo World, a third-person, endless-world ARPG with procedurally generated quests. Recruit any NPC into your party, for better or worse, and be the "hero" that Lan Redic needs!
